handoff_anchor.note: Screen geometry of the accepted 36 km analysis AOI on the last frame, as fractions of the frame with y from the bottom: centre, the four projected corners in corner_order, extent and bounding box. The page-layer handoff maps the governed rasters onto these corners; regional_box is the 420 km acquisition frame, by then outside the frame.

checks.check: aoi stays locked to frame centre after handover
camera speed changes without a jerk
focal length ramps without a snap
checks.unit: fraction of focal length per frame

checks.check: no hidden cut in the camera path
aoi stays in frame from handover to the end
headline-safe region stays clear of the Earth through the establish
satellite stays fully in frame and unoccluded through the acquisition beat
checks.unit: frames clipped, hidden or out of frame

checks.check: satellite sits lower-left of the target through the acquisition beat
satellite never overlaps the target frame during the acquisition beat
satellite is readable at the primary acquisition frame
satellite never becomes a foreground fly-by
sensing lines release while the satellite is still in frame
satellite has left the frame before the analysis hold
analysis AOI spans the declared width through the hold
analysis frame settles for the hold (no size or position creep)
checks.unit: max per-frame change of width, centre

checks.check: analysis frame is fully inside the frame through the hold
checks.unit: hold frames with a corner off-screen

frames_note: every eighth frame plus frame 1; all checks above were computed over the full per-frame series, not this sample
